heard: A cosmic behemoth weighing three quadrillion suns is tearing itself apart. Many assume the most massive galaxy cluster discovered at this distance is a single, peaceful object. In 2012, astronomers analyzed an extreme giant located in the constellation Phoenix. Nicknamed El Gordo, Spanish for the fat one, it produces the most x-rays at its distance. Telescopes revealed this behemoth is actually two subclusters colliding at several million kilometers per hour. The violent crash mirrors the bullet cluster, wrenching normal hot gas away from dark matter. While gas slowed down, dark matter sailed straight through, bending the light of background galaxies. Rather than a single peaceful giant, deep space hides an epic cosmic collision.
